tasks.title: Auto estimate of the cell count
tasks.solution: n = ⌈V / 4.40⌉: 4.40 V is slightly above a full LiHV cell (4.35 V), so that a full pack does not land on the boundary. The estimate is right while the per-cell voltage is above 4.40·(n−1)/n: 3.30 V for 4S, 3.67 V for 6S, 3.85 V for 8S. The trap is 21.0 V: it is both a full 5S (4.20 V/cell) and an empty 6S (3.50 V/cell); the formula gives 5. On a discharged pack (and for 8S and up, even a storage-charged one) the cell count is set with the Cells option.

tasks.title: RxBt alarm threshold
tasks.solution: Threshold = cell count × voltage per cell. If report_cell_voltage is on in Betaflight, RxBt is already the per-cell average and the threshold equals c itself; LinkBox recognizes this case by a value ≤ 4.5 V.

tasks.title: Widget frames per telemetry packet
tasks.solution: Telemetry interval = ratio × 1000 / rate ms (link-elrs), divided by the 50 ms cycle period. Example: 250 Hz, 1:64 → 256 ms → 5.12 calls. Almost every call draws the same numbers, which is why sensor IDs are cached and no tables are created in refresh.
